subject: Customer subscription stopped charging - bug?
body: One of our customers (ref cust_88213) has a monthly plan that just stopped renewing. Looking at the logs on our side it seems like the charge attempt failed a couple of times this week and now nothing is happening at all, no more attempts. Is this a bug on your end? We haven't changed anything about this customer's plan. Need this fixed asap because they're asking us why their subscription got cancelled.
